name: ejector-button
title: Ejector Button
description: A destructive action under the hinged cover of a gear-stick knob, seen in perspective over a leather boot: open the cover (UI SDK's toggle), then press the red button. The cover closes after a timeout, on Escape and once the eject finishes; the button carries data-agent-confirm, and agents get arm, disarm and eject, which fails with why while the cover is closed.

[data-slot=\"ejector-button\"].background: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 50% 38%, #2c2825, transparent 75%), repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.012) 0 2px, transparent 2px 5px), #0e0d0c

[data-slot=\"ejector-button-boot\"].background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6) 0 15%, transparent 30%), repeating-conic-gradient( from 4deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05) 0deg 5deg, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.32) 9deg 13deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.035) 17deg 22.5deg ), repeating-radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.018) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px), radial-gradient(circle at 42% 34%, #4a3f37, #231d19 55%, #0d0b0a)

[data-slot=\"ejector-button-knob-top\"].background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, transparent 66%, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35) 67%, transparent 69%), conic-gradient( from 210deg, #6f6f6f, #f4f4f4 12%, #9a9a9a 25%, #e2e2e2 40%, #7a7a7a 55%, #f0f0f0 70%, #8a8a8a 85%, #6f6f6f )

docs: `<EjectorButton label agentConfirm onEject armTimeoutMs armed|defaultArmed onArmedChange disabled labels>`. `label` names the group and the red button and is engraved on the plate below. The cover is UI SDK's Toggle (`labels.cover`, "Safety cover" by default), pressed while open; the red button can be pressed only then, and is out of the tab order while covered. `onEject({ reason, event })` runs on the press; a returned Promise sets `aria-busy` and `data-pending` until it settles, then the cover closes. `onArmedChange(armed, details)` reports `cover-press`, `timeout` (after `armTimeoutMs`, 5000 by default, 0 for never, counted while idle), `escape-key`, `eject` and `imperative`; `details.cancel()` keeps the cover as it is. Agents call `arm` and `disarm` on the group and `eject` on the button, which waits for a person through `allow` (`agentConfirm` becomes `data-agent-confirm`) and fails with why while the cover is closed. The console is dark in every theme (the item's `css`); under reduced motion the cover fades instead of swinging.
